Provides a resource to create a eniSgAttachment

> **Note:** If this resource is used to bind security groups to eni, it cannot be linked to `tentcloudEni` binding security group for simultaneous use.

## Example Usage

```typescript
import * as pulumi from "@pulumi/pulumi";
import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

const zones = tencentcloud.availability.getZonesByProduct({
    product: "vpc",
});
const vpc = new tencentcloud.vpc.Instance("vpc", {
    name: "vpc-example",
    cidrBlock: "10.0.0.0/16",
});
const subnet = new tencentcloud.subnet.Instance("subnet", {
    availabilityZone: zones.then(zones => zones.zones?.[0]?.name),
    name: "subnet-example",
    vpcId: vpc.id,
    cidrBlock: "10.0.0.0/16",
    isMulticast: false,
});
const example1 = new tencentcloud.security.Group("example1", {
    name: "tf-example-sg1",
    description: "sg desc.",
    projectId: 0,
    tags: {
        example: "test",
    },
});
const example2 = new tencentcloud.security.Group("example2", {
    name: "tf-example-sg2",
    description: "sg desc.",
    projectId: 0,
    tags: {
        example: "test",
    },
});
const example = new tencentcloud.eni.Instance("example", {
    name: "tf-example-eni",
    vpcId: vpc.id,
    subnetId: subnet.id,
    description: "eni desc.",
    ipv4Count: 1,
});
const eniSgAttachment = new tencentcloud.eni.SgAttachment("eni_sg_attachment", {
    networkInterfaceIds: example.id,
    securityGroupIds: [
        example1.id,
        example2.id,
    ],
});
```

```go
package main

import (
	"github.com/pulumi/pulumi/sdk/v3/go/pulumi"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/availability"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/eni"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/security"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/subnet"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/vpc"
)

func main() {
	pulumi.Run(func(ctx *pulumi.Context) error {
		zones, err := availability.GetZonesByProduct(ctx, &availability.GetZonesByProductArgs{
			Product: "vpc",
		}, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		vpc2, err := vpc.NewInstance(ctx, "vpc", &vpc.InstanceArgs{
			Name:      pulumi.String("vpc-example"),
			CidrBlock: pulumi.String("10.0.0.0/16"),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		subnet2, err := subnet.NewInstance(ctx, "subnet", &subnet.InstanceArgs{
			AvailabilityZone: pulumi.String(zones.Zones[0].Name),
			Name:             pulumi.String("subnet-example"),
			VpcId:            vpc2.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			CidrBlock:        pulumi.String("10.0.0.0/16"),
			IsMulticast:      pulumi.Bool(false),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		example1, err := security.NewGroup(ctx, "example1", &security.GroupArgs{
			Name:        pulumi.String("tf-example-sg1"),
			Description: pulumi.String("sg desc."),
			ProjectId:   pulumi.Int(0),
			Tags: pulumi.StringMap{
				"example": pulumi.String("test"),
			},
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		example2, err := security.NewGroup(ctx, "example2", &security.GroupArgs{
			Name:        pulumi.String("tf-example-sg2"),
			Description: pulumi.String("sg desc."),
			ProjectId:   pulumi.Int(0),
			Tags: pulumi.StringMap{
				"example": pulumi.String("test"),
			},
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		example, err := eni.NewInstance(ctx, "example", &eni.InstanceArgs{
			Name:        pulumi.String("tf-example-eni"),
			VpcId:       vpc2.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			SubnetId:    subnet2.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			Description: pulumi.String("eni desc."),
			Ipv4Count:   pulumi.Int(1),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = eni.NewSgAttachment(ctx, "eni_sg_attachment", &eni.SgAttachmentArgs{
			NetworkInterfaceIds: example.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			SecurityGroupIds: pulumi.StringArray{
				example1.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
				example2.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			},
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return nil
	})
}
```

```java
package generated_program;

import com.pulumi.Context;
import com.pulumi.Pulumi;
import com.pulumi.core.Output;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Availability.AvailabilityFunctions;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Availability.inputs.GetZonesByProductArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Security.Group;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Security.GroupArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Eni.SgAttachment;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Eni.SgAttachmentArgs;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Map;
import java.io.File;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Paths;

public class App {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Pulumi.run(App::stack);
    }

    public static void stack(Context ctx) {
        final var zones = AvailabilityFunctions.getZonesByProduct(GetZonesByProductArgs.builder()
            .product("vpc")
            .build());

        var vpc = new com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Vpc.Instance("vpc", com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Vpc.InstanceArgs.builder()
            .name("vpc-example")
            .cidrBlock("10.0.0.0/16")
            .build());

        var subnet = new com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Subnet.Instance("subnet", com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Subnet.InstanceArgs.builder()
            .availabilityZone(zones.zones()[0].name())
            .name("subnet-example")
            .vpcId(vpc.id())
            .cidrBlock("10.0.0.0/16")
            .isMulticast(false)
            .build());

        var example1 = new Group("example1", GroupArgs.builder()
            .name("tf-example-sg1")
            .description("sg desc.")
            .projectId(0)
            .tags(Map.of("example", "test"))
            .build());

        var example2 = new Group("example2", GroupArgs.builder()
            .name("tf-example-sg2")
            .description("sg desc.")
            .projectId(0)
            .tags(Map.of("example", "test"))
            .build());

        var example = new com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Eni.Instance("example", com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Eni.InstanceArgs.builder()
            .name("tf-example-eni")
            .vpcId(vpc.id())
            .subnetId(subnet.id())
            .description("eni desc.")
            .ipv4Count(1)
            .build());

        var eniSgAttachment = new SgAttachment("eniSgAttachment", SgAttachmentArgs.builder()
            .networkInterfaceIds(example.id())
            .securityGroupIds(            
                example1.id(),
                example2.id())
            .build());

    }
}
```

